q1.explanationZh: consequence“结果，后果”，in consequence“因此；结果”。

q2.explanationZh: conserve 去 e 加 -ation 构成名词 conservation“保护”。

q3.explanationZh: conserve 及物动词“保存；保护”，conserve natural resources“保护自然资源”。

q4.explanationZh: consider“认为；考虑”，consider doing sth.“考虑做某事”。

q5.explanationZh: consider 加 -able 构成 considerable“相当大的；重要的”。

q6.explanationZh: considerate“体贴的；考虑周到的”，注意与 considerable“相当大的”区分。

q7.explanationZh: consist 是不及物动词，consist of“由……组成”，不用被动语态。

q9.explanationZh: constant“不断的；持久不变的”，副词 constantly“不断地”。

q10.explanationZh: constitution“宪法；体质；构成”，注意 -tution 的拼写。

q12.explanationZh: construct 加 -ion 构成 construction“建设”，under construction“在建设中”。

q13.explanationZh: consult“请教；查阅”，consult a doctor“看医生”，consult a dictionary“查词典”。

q14.explanationZh: consult 加 -ant 表示人，consultant“顾问”。

q15.explanationZh: consult 加 -ation 构成名词 consultation“咨询；磋商”，in consultation with“与……商议”。

q16.explanationZh: consume“消耗；消费”，名词是 consumption，消费者是 consumer。

q17.explanationZh: consume 加 -r 表示人，consumer“消费者”。

q18.explanationZh: consume 的名词形式 consumption“消费（量）”，注意 m 后面有 p。

q19.explanationZh: contact 可作名词“联系”，也可作及物动词：contact sb.“联系某人”，后面不加 with。

q20.explanationZh: contain“包含，容纳”，强调内含的成分，名词 container 是“容器”。

q21.explanationZh: contain 加 -er 构成 container“容器；集装箱”。

q23.explanationZh: content 作名词“内容；目录”时重音在前 /ˈkɒntent/，常用复数 contents。

q24.explanationZh: contest 名词“竞赛”，动词“争夺”，contest every inch of land“寸土必争”。

q25.explanationZh: context“上下文，语境”，可以从上下文猜词义。

q26.explanationZh: continent“洲；大陆”，the Continent 指“欧洲大陆”。

q27.explanationZh: continue“继续”，continue doing/to do sth.“继续做某事”。

q28.explanationZh: contract 名词“合同”，重音在前；动词“收缩；订合同”，重音在后。

q29.explanationZh: contradictory = contra（相反）+ dict（说）+ -ory，“矛盾的”。

q30.explanationZh: contrary“相反的；反面”，on the contrary“正相反”。

q31.explanationZh: contrast 名词“对比”，动词“（使）成对比”，by contrast“对比之下”。

q32.explanationZh: contribute“贡献；捐献”，contribute to“有助于；促成”。

q33.explanationZh: contribute 去 e 加 -ion 构成 contribution“贡献”，make a contribution to“对……作出贡献”。

q34.explanationZh: control 动词、名词同形，过去式 controlled 要双写 l；out of control“失去控制”。

q35.explanationZh: controversial“有争议的”，名词 controversy“争议”。

q36.explanationZh: convenience 是名词“方便”，at your convenience“在你方便的时候”。

q37.explanationZh: convenient 是形容词“方便的”，反义词 inconvenient。

q38.explanationZh: conventional“习惯的；依照惯例的”，由 convention（惯例）加 -al 构成。

q39.explanationZh: conversation“谈话”，have a conversation with sb.“与某人交谈”。

q40.explanationZh: convey“运送；传达”，convey ideas“传达理念”，过去式 conveyed。

q41.explanationZh: convince“使确信；说服”，convince sb. of sth.“使某人相信某事”。

q42.explanationZh: consider sb./sth. (as/to be) ...“把……看作……”，as 和 to be 可以省略。

accept: It's considerate of sb. to do sth.
It is considerate of sb. to do sth.
It's considerate of sb to do sth
It is considerate of sb to do sth
It's considerate of sb. to do sth

q43.explanationZh: considerate 描述人的品质，句型用 It’s considerate of sb. to do sth.，介词用 of 而不是 for。

q44.explanationZh: consider 后接动名词：consider doing sth.“考虑做某事”。

q46.explanationZh: contest 作动词“争夺”，contest every inch of land“寸土必争”。

q47.explanationZh: convince sb. of sth.“使某人相信某事”，被动 be convinced of sth.“确信某事”。

q48.explanationZh: at your convenience“在你方便的时候”，convenience 是名词。

q49.explanationZh: have/bring/get/keep ... under control“把……控制住”，under control“在控制之下”。

q50.explanationZh: consist of“由……组成”，一般用主动语态，相当于 be made up of。

q51.explanationZh: be in contact with 表示状态“与……有联系”。

q52.explanationZh: come into contact with“接触”，表示开始接触这一动作。

q53.explanationZh: have/make contact with“与……有联系”，lose contact with“与……失去联系”。

q54.explanationZh: be contrary to“与……相反”，to 是介词。

q55.explanationZh: on the contrary“正相反”，常用来否定前面的说法。

q56.explanationZh: contribute to“有助于；造成”，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

q57.explanationZh: “这种铁含碳约 4%”，contain 强调内含的成分；主语 this kind of iron 是单数，一般现在时用 contains。

q58.explanationZh: consider doing sth.“考虑做某事”；Have you ever 后接过去分词 considered。

q59.explanationZh: milk consumption“牛奶消费量”，此处需要名词作主语，用 consumption。

q60.explanationZh: chemistry contest“化学竞赛”，this 后接名词单数 contest。

q61.explanationZh: “他对生理学发展的新贡献”，his new 后接名词，contribution to“对……的贡献”。

q62.explanationZh: “传递理念”用 convey；have 后接过去分词 conveyed，构成现在完成时。

q63.explanationZh: “为错误造成的后果付出代价”，consequence“后果”，这里用复数 consequences。

q64.explanationZh: “没有必要继续我们的讨论”，to 后接动词原形 continue。

q65.explanationZh: “蔬菜水果含有多种维生素”，主语是复数，一般现在时用 contain。

q66.explanationZh: “网站的内容越实用……”，content 名词“内容”，谓语 is 说明这里用单数 content。

q67.sampleAnswer: We must convince the students of the need for extensive reading.
references: We must convince the students of the need for extensive reading.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “让某人认识到某事”= convince sb. of sth.；“……的必要性”= the need for...；“广泛阅读”= extensive reading。

q68.sampleAnswer: The old man seems to be content with the free life after retirement despite his average living conditions.
references: The old man seems to be content with the free life after retirement despite his average living conditions.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “满足于……”= be content with...，content 作形容词；“尽管”可用介词 despite 加名词短语。

q69.sampleAnswer: I’m always convinced that one can better fight against negative emotions when he sleeps well.
references: I’m always convinced that one can better fight against negative emotions when he sleeps well.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “相信”= be convinced that...（that 从句作宾语）；“抵御负面情绪”= fight against negative emotions。

q70.sampleAnswer: The school’s homework policy was revised in consultation with the teaching staff.
references: The school’s homework policy was revised in consultation with the teaching staff.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “与……商议”= in consultation with...；政策“被修订”用被动语态 was revised。

q71.sampleAnswer: Shares and bonds can bring one quite a considerable additional income.
references: Shares and bonds can bring one quite a considerable additional income.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “不菲的”= considerable（相当大的）；“给某人带来某物”= bring sb. sth.。

q72.sampleAnswer: The conclusion that we drew in the chemistry experiment class was contrary to our expectations.
references: The conclusion that we drew in the chemistry experiment class was contrary to our expectations.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: “与……相反”= be contrary to...；that we drew... 是定语从句，修饰 the conclusion。

q73.sampleAnswer: When we get along with others, we should learn to put ourselves in others’ shoes and be considerate of the difficulties of others.
references: When we get along with others, we should learn to put ourselves in others’ shoes and be considerate of the difficulties of others.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q73.explanationZh: “体谅……”= be considerate of...；“换位思考”= put oneself in others’ shoes；“与人相处”= get along with others。

q74.sampleAnswer: Frankly speaking, what you said at the meeting yesterday is still controversial.
references: Frankly speaking, what you said at the meeting yesterday is still controversial.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q74.explanationZh: “有争议的”= controversial；“你表达的观点”可用 what 引导的主语从句 what you said。

q75.sampleAnswer: In Western countries, it is quite common for a person to consult a psychologist when he has some psychological problems.
references: In Western countries, it is quite common for a person to consult a psychologist when he has some psychological problems.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q75.explanationZh: “咨询心理医生”= consult a psychologist；it is common for sb. to do sth.“某人做某事很普遍”，it 是形式主语。

q76.sampleAnswer: Since the project was launched, it has consumed a lot of time and funds, but whether all the tasks can be accomplished in time remains to be seen.
references: Since the project was launched, it has consumed a lot of time and funds, but whether all the tasks can be accomplished in time remains to be seen.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q76.explanationZh: “消耗”= consume；since 引导的时间状语与现在完成时 has consumed 连用；“还有待观察”= remains to be seen，whether 引导主语从句。
q76.rubricZh: 书末答案原印 a lot of time and fund（fund 漏复数），经人工复核按手册 consume 例句更正为 funds（GitHub #136）。
